text:
elaine.prodeng: Short update for everyone  Finance is changing invoice remittance windows and were introducing a small quota cushion for hosted accounts. Posting here so product, eng, and support can prepare comms and migrations.

billing-bot: [Draft] Internal memo saved: https://redwood.internal/billing/remittance-cushion-2026 (preview)

mark.billing: Summary: 1) Invoice remittance will shift from net-30 to net-28 for new invoices issued after 2026-06-01 to improve cash forecasting. 2) For hosted customers were adding a non-bill cushion of 5000 tokens per org per month (applies to free-tier and metered accounts) to reduce billing noise from tiny spikes. Dedicated contracts unchanged.

elaine.prodeng: This is a payments/ops change. Were not increasing unit prices. Language for external comms should emphasize improved predictability and fewer surprise micro-overages.

cfo.sara: Rationale: net-28 reduces our receivables aging by ~6%. The cushion was modeled to cut ~12% of micro-refund requests. Well include the cushion amount on invoices as a separate line_type: "token_cushion" with unit "tokens" and amount 0.

engops.nick: Ops details: quota cushion will be applied in the billing layer only and will not change rate-limit enforcement; customers who exceed their quota by more than cushion will see the usual soft-limit behavior (warning at 80%, soft-throttle at 120%). Well emit an audit event when cushion is consumed.

support.tess: Support note: please prepare canned replies. Suggested reply: "We now include a small monthly token cushion so minor spikes don't produce charges. Your invoice will show a 'token_cushion' line for transparency."

mark.billing: Action items:
- Product: update billing settings UX to show net-28 payment terms for new invoices and display cushion meter.
- Eng: include new invoice CSV column `cushion_applied` (true/false) and add `line_type=token_cushion` for clarity. Also surface cushion consumption events in the usage API.
- Support: prepare refund playbook for cases where cushion didn't prevent a charge.
- Finance: update A/R templates and set dunning cadence accordingly.

billing-bot: Example invoice snippet (preview):
```
schema_version=3
invoice_id,line_type,usage_units,unit_price,amount,region_code,cushion_applied
inv_20260601,token_cushion,5000,0.00,0.00,us-west,true
inv_20260601,tokens,125000,0.0005,62.50,us-west,false
```

engops.nick: Migration window: invoice export schema update planned 2026-05-28 01:00-02:00 UTC. Exports during that hour may be delayed or produce `schema_version=3` files only. We'll add a deprecation notice to the export docs for schema_version=2.

cfo.sara: Note about existing invoices: only invoices created on or after 2026-06-01 will default to net-28. Outstanding invoices keep their original terms.

elaine.prodeng: Communication timeline proposal: internal heads-up today, support article + small blog post 2026-05-15, emails to finance contacts on 2026-05-20. Objections?

mark.billing: Please avoid buzzwords like "free buffer" in external text. Use "small monthly token cushion" and show exact numbers.

support.tess: Quick Q: partners who resell invoices  will their invoices show cushion lines?

mark.billing: Good call  partner invoices will include cushion metadata if the platform issues the invoice; reseller platforms may choose to hide it. We'll send partner-facing guidance.

engops.nick: One engineering callout: adding `cushion_applied` means downstream CSV parsers must handle an extra boolean column. We'll add `schema_version=3` and publish migration snippets for python/js.

cfo.sara: Finance approves the plan. We'll monitor short-term AR effects and report back after month 1.

elaine.prodeng: Thanks everyone. Ill post the final copy and the support article link here once theyre live. :thumbsup:
